task.title: Change the interface theme
task.shortdesc: Select system, light, or dark theme without changing profile content.

prereq.p: Open BPM or the product documentation portal in the browser.

context.p: Theme selection affects only presentation. BPM and the documentation portal support System, Light, and Dark modes without changing profile or help content.

step.cmd: Open the theme selector in the current page header.

info.p: Expected result: the selector shows System, Light, and Dark without changing the current route, locale, or selected profile.
Expected result: System follows the operating-system preference; Light and Dark apply the explicit mode on supported BPM and documentation surfaces.

step.cmd: Check editor panels, tables, notes, code blocks, focus indicators, and validation states.

info.p: Expected result: content remains readable; the documentation Light mode uses comfortable light-gray primary surfaces rather than a pure-white page.

step.cmd: Continue editing after confirming that unsaved profile data is still present.

info.note: Save or deliberately discard changes before leaving an editor, closing a tab, or confirming an irreversible action.

result.p: BPM and the product documentation use the selected visual theme across supported surfaces.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the visible state is unclear, stop editing, read the current status message, refresh once, and reopen the profile from the Library.
